QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_7

question.text: As per SEBI's operational framework for AIF performance benchmarking, which Indian association's membership threshold is used for notifying Benchmarking Agencies, and which three agencies currently publish AIF benchmarks?

answer.text: IVCA, representing at least 33% of AIFs; agencies are CRISIL, NSE and Preqin.
AMFI, representing at least 51% of AIFs; agencies are CRISIL, ICRA and CARE.
APMI, representing at least 25% of AIFs; agencies are Cambridge, Preqin and PitchBook.
SEBI itself directly appoints Value Research, CRISIL and Morningstar.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 7.6, an association of AIFs representing at least 33% of the number of AIFs may notify one or more Benchmarking Agencies. The Indian Private Equity & Venture Capital Association (IVCA) has done so, and the three benchmarking agencies currently publishing AIF benchmarks are CRISIL, NSE and Preqin. The Trap: AMFI is for mutual funds; APMI is for portfolio managers (not AIFs); SEBI sets the framework but does not directly appoint benchmarking agencies. Note: The 33% threshold and the IVCA-appointed agencies (CRISIL, NSE, Preqin) are the workbook's specific operational facts.
